title: USC4AM primary expense, attendance and governance records
summary: Targets primary records needed to determine attendance, approval, reimbursement compliance and local-government decision authority.

data.target: USC4AM Oakland County primary expense, attendance and governance records
data.research_question: What primary records establish who attended the Milwaukee and Texas USC4AM events, who approved county spending, whether reimbursements complied with policy, and how the executive committee documented decisions?
objectives: Obtain Oakland County travel authorizations, expense reports, itemized receipts, lost-receipt affidavits and approver signatures.
Obtain official USC4AM agendas, attendee rosters, invitations, minutes and event venues.
Reconcile charged dates, routes and amounts against official event schedules.
Identify funding accounts and county budget lines used for each trip.
Obtain executive-committee appointment records, minutes, conflict disclosures and recusal records.
Track corrections to stale Oakland County personnel pages.
Record a bounded negative result if primary records remain unavailable.
in_scope: USC4AM official event and governance records
preferred_sources: court or ethics filings if any
selection_reason: Primary event records now exist for both reported conference trips.
Attendance and reimbursement compliance remain unresolved.
Current local-government and Center governance overlap is confirmed.

caveats: The target tests compliance and documentation; it does not presume misconduct.

workflow.next_action: Search primary county and Center records by event, traveler, date and funding account.
